question.text: Which type of REIT owns and manages warehouses and industrial facilities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 277 explains that REITs include warehouses, and that Industrial REITs own and manage industrial facilities. Office REITs invest in office buildings, Retail REITs in shopping centres/malls, and Timberland REITs in forest land for timber. The Trap: Industrial and office properties are both commercial; the source-backed differentiator is industrial facilities and warehouses for Industrial REITs versus professional office space for Office REITs. Note: When categorising a REIT, anchor the description to the asset type the workbook lists — here, warehouses and industrial facilities.
